# Cognitive Psychology - Ruhr University Bochum

> The Department of Cognitive Psychology at Ruhr University Bochum conducts research on stress, emotion regulation, memory consolidation, and spatial navigation with DFG-funded collaborative research centers.

This is the official website of the Department of Cognitive Psychology at Ruhr University Bochum's Faculty of Psychology. The department, led by Oliver T. Wolf, focuses on empirical research in cognitive and emotional processes, with active participation in major collaborative research initiatives (SFB 1280, SFB 874) and a comprehensive teaching program for undergraduate and graduate students.
